name: Hierarchical Planes 8-Connectivity (HP8T)
definition: A variant of HP4T that simplifies the calculation for the non-hit axis by removing clamping, resulting in 8-connectivity (allowing diagonal jumps). The resulting grid_position may contain fractional values and must be floored before grid access.
summary: HP8T is a ray traversal algorithm that simplifies hierarchical grid updates by allowing diagonal jumps, reducing computational overhead compared to HP4T.
